about.title: About me
about.desc: A backend and AI engineer — I build scalable systems and integrate AI into them.
about.intro: I grew up in Fergana and am currently planning a move to Tashkent. I'm studying for a B.Sc in Economics, but I spend most of my time writing code: building scalable, fault-tolerant systems and integrating AI into them. I try to automate as much as I can — handing off repetitive work to code so I can spend my own attention on the interesting problems.
